shortDescription: Manipulate remote syslog settings on a BIG-IP

options.name: local_ip
options.description: Specifies the local IP address of the system that is logging. To provide no local IP, specify the value C(none). When creating a remote syslog, if this parameter is not specified, the default value is C(none).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the syslog object. This option is required when multiple C(remote_host)s with the same IP or hostname are present on the device. If C(name) is not provided, C(remote_host) is used by default.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: remote_host
options.description: Specifies the IP address or hostname for the remote system, to which the system sends log messages.

options.name: remote_port
options.description: Specifies the port the system uses to send messages to the remote logging server. When creating a remote syslog, if this parameter is not specified, the default value is C(514).

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), guarantees the remote syslog exists with the provided attributes. When C(absent), removes the remote syslog from the system.
